rules.rule2: keep raw differences as a ruler or weight instead of renormalising them away
rules.rule3: preserve the chiral source of asymmetry

external.X:Thurston: W. P. Thurston, Geometry and Topology of Three-Manifolds, ch. 4: figure-eight complement from two regular ideal tetrahedra.
external.X:Riley: R. Riley 1975, parabolic representation of the figure-eight knot group over Z[w].
external.X:Q1: Ramanujan Challenge Q1 (pi PCF): convergence ratio (123+55 sqrt5)/2 = phi^10, saddle in Q(sqrt5) (official Lemma 5; checked in his ladder-paper notes).
external.X:Apery: Apery zeta(3) recurrence, limiting polynomial l^2 - 34 l + 1, roots (sqrt2 -+ 1)^4.
external.X:Saddle: Shared saddle quadratic t^2+2t-1=0 of Beukers' Apery integrand and Problem 2.5 (his ladder paper, T = 34 closed 2026-08-31).
external.X:Hessian-July: His July 13 2026 paper on the figure-eight A-polynomial (rebuilt 8 Aug as 'Axis-Aligned Tangent Cones at the Singular Points of the Figure-Eight A-Polynomial, and the Amphichiral Involution'): corrected discriminant, ramification vs nodes, palindromic involution = amphichirality.
external.X:Borot-Eynard: Borot and Eynard, arXiv:1205.2261: for 4_1 the involution (m,l) -> (m,1/l) coincides with the amphichiral symmetry; ramification points at m^2 = (3 +- sqrt5)/2, l = 1 and m^2 = (-1 +- i sqrt3)/2, l = -1.
external.X:votkp-chiral-vortex: votkp-lean old-Grok-chats salvage: 'chiral vortex knot of memory' = the VOTKP electron chain (section F).
external.X:DT-audit: Ink, dirac_builds_audit_v1 (Dirac Time / VOTKP old-chats pipeline): the three exact DT-O14 survivors -- chiral eta killing law, Alexander wall criterion on S^1, circle odometer DT-E15.
external.X:BHL2010: K. Bringmann, K. Hikami, J. Lovejoy, 'On the modularity of the unified WRT invariants of certain Seifert manifolds' (M(2,3,8), M(2,3,4) from +-2 surgery on the trefoil), Thms 1.1-1.2, Eqs. (1.3)-(1.7).
external.X:APS: Atiyah-Patodi-Singer spectral asymmetry: eta(D) = signed eigenvalue count; finite-dimensional version formalized here.
external.X:D28-statements: Ink, D28 new_lean_statements_v1: exact claims of combined_paper_v1.tex not previously proved in Lean.

kinds.same-polynomial: both sides are governed by one explicit polynomial (proved)
kinds.same-root: the same algebraic root realised in two places (proved)
kinds.same-value: the same integer arises from two constructions (proved)
kinds.square-of: one object is the square of the other (proved)
kinds.converse: the two statements are the two directions of an iff
kinds.evaluates-in: a general-ring identity evaluated at a concrete element
kinds.kept-difference: a defect or sign kept as a measurement (rule 2)
kinds.contrast: two objects differing in a proved invariant
kinds.proof-step: one theorem is used to obtain the other
kinds.ladder-step: a rung of the trace ladder
kinds.generalizes: one statement is a special case of the other
kinds.boundary: marks the band edge between regimes
kinds.anchor: ties a theorem to a named classical source
kinds.external: links to his other work or the literature; the link is recorded, not proved here
kinds.analogy-only: structural pointer with NO theorem behind it -- flagged so it is never cited as proved
